extracted.intended_audience: telecom and IP professionals: patent owners, licensing teams, litigation counsels, R&D and corporate strategy teams evaluating 5G SEPs
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating and using a commercial dashboard that curates, verifies, and analyzes declared 5G Standard Essential Patents (SEPs) to support licensing, litigation, and strategic IP decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: True SEP Essentiality — Verified by Experts
rubrics_metrics.description: Over 20,000+ patent families rigorously reviewed to determine whether they are truly essential to 5G technical standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Don't rely on inflated or speculative declarations. This verification identifies high-value patents that matter in licensing and litigation; expert review is presented as the basis for distinguishing truly essential patents from mere declarations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global SEP Grant Visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: A clear, interactive view of where each patent family is granted—across the US, EU, China, Japan, Korea, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use jurisdictional grant visibility to focus legal and commercial efforts on jurisdictions with enforceable rights, spot litigation hotspots, and assess global licensing leverage at a glance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litigation & FRAND Risk Intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: SEP families are flagged for prior or ongoing litigation and public licensing program participation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify contentious patents early to avoid surprise disputes, and strengthen your position in FRAND negotiations or defensive planning by surfacing litigation history and public licensing activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Portfolio Ownership & Transfer Tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Insight into M&A activity, portfolio sales, and assignee changes—accurate as of Dec 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track ownership shifts so you know who controls key SEPs; don't negotiate with the wrong party. Use transfer tracking to understand how changes in ownership affect licensing exposure and legal strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company & Portfolio Rankings
rubrics_metrics.description: Instantly identify which companies lead the 5G SEP space by volume, strength, and essentiality of their portfolios.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage rankings to make competitive comparisons, assess licensing concentration, or evaluate target partners/acquirers with confidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data You Can Trust — Curated, Not Crawled
rubrics_metrics.description: A dashboard built by telecom/IP professionals, not just scraped or auto-processed data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes auditable, transparent, and defensible analysis; accuracy is presented as essential for strategic decisions. Prefer curated/expert-validated data over unvetted automated aggregations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuously Updated Insights
rubrics_metrics.description: A series of continuously updated insights designed to reflect the ever-evolving dynamics of declaration activity, ownership transfers, and technical standard alignment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use continuously updated data to ensure analysis reflects current declaration activity and portfolio changes; timely updates are framed as necessary for accurate strategic and legal decision-making.
